title: studying
description: Morphism: (subject, claim-record[], swarm, opts) -> studied-subject. Settles a subject's claim-lattice into accepted truth. Observers each hold a FOUR value; consensus is the knowledge-order meet; acceptance is by a STUB truth-confidence heuristic (|mean truth-lean| >= threshold). The real consensus/disagreement measure -- the sheaf Laplacian over the observer network sheaf (moduli-descent-laplacian; Hansen-Ghrist) -- is a separate derived apparatus and is DEFERRED, not reimplemented here. A subject below threshold is UNSETTLED: its contradiction is a DEMAND the swarm (injected, fungible) satisfies by reading files and positing more claims; re-settle until confident or the round budget is spent. PURE given the swarm. HACKING: name + stub-confidence admitted.
